verdicts.reason: A keeps the player card intact and centred, with its internal alignment matching the original. But the card is small for the square canvas, its fine text ('By Amy Jean', the timestamps) is tiny, and there is an odd translucent vertical band across the background. B enlarges the card but breaks it: 'By Amy Jean' collides with the avatar, the avatar overlaps the title pill, 'MARKETING' and 'WEEKLY REVIEW' are no longer centred, and '01:58' has moved next to '00:00' instead of sitting at the right end of the bar. It also has the same background band.
